One overlooked clue can rewrite centuries of history if you know where to look. Plunge into the most gripping investigations of Unexplained and Unexplored as explorers track down lost clues and missing pieces behind vanished cities, secret expeditions, and unexplained relics. Relive the sharpest breakthroughs, strangest discoveries, and biggest unanswered questions from across the globe.
Watch Unexplained and Unexplored Season 1 Episodes 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 & 8 on Discovery Channel India.
